item.title: How Context Graphs Turn Agent Traces into Durable Business Assets
item.description:
Date: January 08, 2026
Tags: ["Enterprise AI", "Data Management", "Context Graphs", "Decision Tracing", "Business Intelligence"]
Summary:
  • Context graphs capture decision traces in enterprise data.
  • They record why agents took specific actions.
  • This creates durable, queryable business assets.
  • Agents combine structured data with human context.
  • These assets improve over time through auditing and querying.

item.title: Why Enterprises Need a Real AI Security Standard for LLMs and Agents
item.description:
Author: Lasso Security Team
Date: N/A
Tags: ["AI Security", "Enterprise Technology", "Large Language Models", "Cybersecurity", "Risk Management"]
Summary:
  • LLMs and AI agents bring new security risks to enterprises.
  • Existing standards do not address AI-specific threats.
  • A dedicated AI security framework is needed.
  • Key risks include prompt injection and data leakage.
  • The framework should cover risk assessment, monitoring, and incident response.
  • Collaboration on AI security standards is essential.
